apps.name: Playd
apps.subtitle: Track your gaming journey
apps.localizedDescription: Playd is your personal game tracker. Add games from IGDB, track what you're playing, manage your backlog, and sync your library with Playd Cloud.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Playd finds your PC on the local network to sync your library, lists, notes, and playtime, and, when you turn on PC Remote, to control that PC.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Playd may use the camera for future features.

versions.localizedDescription: Paste to an open PC was saved to Playd Cloud and never reached Windows. Leaving the iPhone app cleared its connection while Playd was still open, and Windows ignored that cloud clipboard because the phone still looked connected. Paste now finds that PC again and puts the clipboard on Windows. A paste from the last two minutes still arrives if the local connection is missed. Update the Windows companion too.

Paste now confirms receipt on the PC instead of treating a cloud save as a completed paste. Copy multiple pictures, files, and folders between iPhone and Windows on the same local network. Files are saved to Downloads; on iPhone, find them under Files > On My iPhone > Playd > Downloads. Achievement banners are pure black and rounded, with a gentler reveal and the new achievement sound. iOS power controls can run in the background on the local network. Copy and Paste still open the app so they can use the clipboard. Update the Windows companion on your PC too.

Fixes away-from-home PC Remote connections that stayed on Approved, connecting... for about a minute before failing and retrying. iPhone and Android request TURN relay credentials on the first attempt and bound cellular/IPv6 ICE gathering once a relay candidate is ready, while Windows falls back across TURN transports, refreshes cached TURN credentials on failure, and confirms the control channel before marking a session connected. Update the Windows companion on your PC too.

PC Remote now connects reliably from iPhone and Android. The Windows companion starts the secure remote data channel itself when the phone owns the session, fixing the loop where the app stayed on Approved. Connecting... and then disconnected. Update the Windows companion on the PC you connect to.

PC Remote works over your local network without internet using encrypted direct connections and one-time approval on the PC. Approvals, disconnects and revocation are shared across LAN and account connections. Android 3.5.9 is included again as an optimized APK that installs in place. Update the Windows companion too.

PC Remote now encrypts LAN connections and verifies the PC certificate during pairing. New account devices require approval on the PC. Approval, reconnect and session takeover handling are more reliable. Windows adds active-viewer controls, session history and safer update cleanup. Update the Windows companion too.

Windows imports Steam playtime and unlocked achievements automatically from the local Steam client. PC Remote confirms shutdown and hibernate requests before powering off, fetches automatic relay credentials when away from home, and redesigns the Android remote layout. iPhone adds dedicated Control Center controls for Copy, Paste, Turn On, Shut Down, and Hibernate PC.

Rating bars change color smoothly as the score rises. An 11/10 rating gets a gold finish with a moving highlight, soft glow and small glints. Windows adds quiet rating clicks and a separate sound toggle. Respects motion settings on both platforms. This release updates iPhone and Windows.

Paste sends text and images from iPhone directly to Playd on Windows over the same Wi-Fi and confirms delivery. Clipboard results appear in a small top toast without a Done button. Windows fixes JPEG transfers, retries brief clipboard locks, and includes the animated bottom toast. Update both apps.

Hiding Playd on Windows releases the decoded covers, so the tray uses much less memory. The account clipboard is read only when you Copy or Paste, including from Control Center. Edition titles such as Redux and Next-Gen match the base game, and the hero and banner open from the art. Update the Windows companion too.

Universal Clipboard shares a copy between iPhone and Playd on Windows until you copy something else. Play launches the game instead of a checksum tool or DirectX setup, on-screen playtime is in minutes, and saved artwork stays put. Update the Windows companion too.

Game detail sheets now fill the top banner edge-to-edge and dismiss by swiping down, Discover covers trim framed borders cleanly with rounded corners, and PC Remote connects faster with reliable signaling retries. Update the Windows companion too.
Game details now show Metacritic scores by platform and improved artwork. This update also improves cloud sync, saved-game matching, and PC Remote reliability. Update the Windows companion too.

Discover, game search, game details, screenshots, and store links now run on IGDB with Steam Metascore enrichment, replacing RAWG. Existing library items keep their history, playtime, ratings, and lists. Update the Windows companion too.

Watch another PC live from the iPhone or a second Windows copy on the same account. The pointer follows your movement, and remote pictures are no longer stored in the cloud. Update the Windows companion too.
Safer backup restores and playtime recovery, corrected CSV import and undo, and more reliable remote controls. Faster large libraries and assistant preparation. Update the Windows companion too.

Redesigned rating controls with thicker tracks, cleaner markers, 0.1 steps, and automatic saving. Windows screenshots stay stable while rating. Safer Playd Cloud upgrades and pending LAN sync recovery. Update the Windows companion too.
Zoom and pan directly on the PC monitor image. Zooming requests sharper frames, up to 4K, with improved text detail and live preview delivery. Update the Windows companion too.
Live away-from-home PC remote, a rating control that saves as you move it, scheduled hibernate that still happens if you close Playd, and faster library screens.
Portable Windows updater repair, reliable library and playtime sync, remote command recovery, iPad backup sharing, and desktop responsiveness.

🔔 Custom Notifications (iOS)

• Added support for Bark notifications
• Game covers now appear in notifications!

🔧 Bug Fixes

• Fixed Alan Wake II crack status detection (Roman numerals now properly converted)

• Fixed inaccurate list counts (stale UUIDs cleaned up)
• Tracked games now properly deleted when removed from all lists
• Screenshot gallery now has smooth hero zoom animation

• Fixed buttons to be circular (not capsule)
• Blue checkmark tint restored

✨ Also includes:
